name: coffee-shop-management-system
description: Web app orchestration for the coffee shop POS and management system.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.publish:check: npm run build && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
